entries.deciding: document.rs save: update(record,text) then record := updated on success, unchanged on refusal
update Valid replaces version with the parsed version, no ordering check
update Empty sets version SNAP and keeps other record fields (transcribes the empty-stream branch of UpdatePersistentFromStream)
delete clears record and doc, leaves classes
save failure branch writes doc := Text::Empty and keeps the record
entries.gap: The emptied text after a refused save is written into the failure branch (premise: Clear runs outside the transaction and the rollback discards the write); the Clear/TSTART/rollback sequence is not modelled, so C:D44 holds by construction.

entries.deciding: update Valid sets imported_name := r.name, so the name-mismatch guard is unreachable
entries.gap: The imported name is fixed to the record name by premise (import onto an existing object keeps its Name); the guard exists but its deciding value is a constant, so acceptance under the old name holds by construction (same pattern as resolve_bounded).

entries.deciding: iter3/resources.rs requirement_failures: ExcludeHealth iff health Off and environment Health
requirement_failures: NeedHealth iff health On and environment not Health
entries.note: Review-71 thought no NeedHealth neighbour was exercised. requirement_neighbors :186 (non-Health instance, NeedHealth present) and :180 (Health instance, no NeedHealth) cover both sides, and both mutants are killed.

entries.deciding: interop failure = (Interoperability==1 || health On) && !namespace interoperability
entries.gap: Only the interoperability-off namespace is exercised with Health=true (:180, :186); the "on" neighbour (Health=true on an interoperability-enabled namespace, no failure) is never asserted, so a rule failing Health=true regardless of the namespace (G6-m73) verifies.

entries.deciding: Interoperability=2 (disabled) adds no failure on an enabled namespace
SYSNamespace failure iff flag and namespace != %SYS
iter36 installer.rs: installer variables from param_* (Parameter, -D), Invoke arguments from custom_* (Default, -D)
entries.note: Mutation recorded as "invalid" by the first mutate.py version; its log shows a by(compute) assertion that simplifies to false, so the mutant is killed. Fixture module m36a declares greeting only as <Default> and mode as <Parameter>.

entries.deciding: param_mode/param_greeting/custom_greeting = or(-D value, declared value); attr_evaluator parameter_precedence general
attr_evaluator evaluate returns raw unchanged when it has no "{", else the pipeline result
name_matches compares lower(pattern) with lower(name)
system_expression transcribes the name switch (namespace/ns, namespaceLower lowered, mgrDir); replace_refs prefers local over system
macro_value returns definitions[name] when defined, else empty
entries.gap: Only the undefined-macro case is exercised (undefined_macro_is_empty); no theorem asserts that a defined macro yields its value, so a macro_value returning nothing for defined macros (G6-m77) verifies.

entries.deciding: evaluate_expression = expression(interpreter(strip_leading(raw))), expression(None) = empty
entries.gap: The success case is never asserted to yield the interpreter value (expression_strips_leading_blank compares the function with itself); an expression() that always returns nothing (G6-m78) verifies. The interpreter result is an input (provider).

entries.deciding: evaluate brace gate precedes macro/parameter/expression pipeline; brace-free value keeps generated_macro_class false
env_config replacement fails on "$" not followed by 0/1 (ICU replacement syntax transcribed); matched_dollar_can_fail
name_matches treats "." in the pattern as a wildcard
resolve_bounded returns circular_error false on every branch
entries.gap: Settled by review-71: resolve_bounded sets circular_error false on every branch (attr_evaluator.rs:178,181), so declared_cycle_error_is_unreachable holds by construction; the product loop and its guard (Default.cls:69-75) are not modelled.

entries.deciding: regex_replace_match quotes backslashes before ICU replacement; backslash_quote_is_inverse general
replacement of a matched value containing "$5" returns None (error); unmatched keeps text
resolve_bounded returns circular_error false on every branch
entries.gap: Settled by review-71: resolve_bounded returns circular_error false on every branch (attr_evaluator.rs:178,181), so declared_cycle_error_is_unreachable is true by construction; the product loop and its circular-reference guard are not modelled.

entries.deciding: inputs.rs delimiter(None) = comma; split at the delimiter
split only at the configured delimiter (pipe keeps commas)
env_config load_file fails when read_parse_ok is false (input)
entries.gap: Settled by review-71: no theorem or control covers the readable-file case; a loader that always fails (G6-m94) still verifies (env_config.rs:121-141). Readability is an input.

entries.deciding: merge_value: atoms replace, containers merge key by key keeping old-only keys; load_files folds in order
compile_single(config_empty) = !config_empty; generator_visible same process
merge_value merges arrays by index (array containers use the same keyed merge)
load_files stops at the first failed file and returns empty config; failure is the input read_parse_ok
entries.gap: Settled by review-71 (same weakness as module.env#4): the success branch of load_file is never exercised with a readable file, so a loader that always fails verifies (G6-m94); file readability/parse success is an input.

entries.deciding: generator_visible(same_process, value) = value if same process else None; singleton_get
entries.gap: Fresh-worker emptiness is a two-case table in generator_visible; the process-private storage of the configuration is not modelled, so "a fresh worker starts empty" is written down rather than derived.
